steps: Verify Ann's identity using her government-issued photo ID and Social Security Number.
Collect Ann's contact information: phone number, email, and current residential address.
Select account type: 'Standard Checking Account' with no monthly fee.
Set up initial deposit of $100 to activate the account.
Generate and provide Ann with her new account number and debit card details.
Email Ann a confirmation of account opening and link to online banking setup.
